faq.compatibleA: Ifowuni yakho kufuneka ixhase i-eSIM kwaye ingatshixwanga kwinethiwekhi enye. Uninzi lwee-iPhone ukusukela kwi-XS, i-Google Pixel 3 nangaphezulu, kunye neemodeli zamva nje ze-Samsung Galaxy ziyayixhasa.
faq.whenA: Yifake phambi kokuhamba xa usene-Wi-Fi. Iphakheji iqala xa iqala ukuqhagamshela apho uya khona, ngaphandle kokuba iphakheji ithi kungenjalo.

numbers.description: Inombolo yeselula yokwenyani kwi-eSIM, yeefowuni, ii-SMS nedatha. Khetha inombolo, wongeze ityala nephakheji yedatha ukuba uyathanda.
numbers.none: Akukho nombolo zihambelanayo. Zama enye ikhowudi yelizwe okanye amanani ambalwa.

numbers.holdHint: Inombolo igcinelwa wena imizuzu eli-10 xa uqala ukuhlawula. Iinkcukacha zokufaka ziza kuba kwi-akhawunti yakho emva kokuhlawula.

numbers.chargedAtRate: Ngezinga lotshintshiselwano langoku {amount} = {price}, ngoko uya kuhlawula {price} xa uhlawula.
numbers.riskTitle: Before you buy — service and account risks
numbers.risk1: Because of the war and EU sanctions, this eSIM does not work in Russia or Iran. Do not buy it for use there.
numbers.risk2: Text messages and one-time codes from third parties (banks, apps, social networks) are not guaranteed; some codes may never be sent to +372 numbers at all.
numbers.risk3: Failed verification codes are not refunded. A third party refusing to send to your number is not a reason for a refund.
numbers.risk4: Emergency calls are not guaranteed. Do not rely on this eSIM as your only way to reach emergency services; keep another local means of communication.
numbers.risk5: Sign-up checks by Google, Telegram, WhatsApp and others are outside our control; failures they cause are not refunded.
numbers.risk6: Call forwarding can send calls to a number in any country; forwarded calls are charged to the number's credit.
numbers.risk7: Some devices and services (including iMessage and FaceTime) may send activation texts automatically when the eSIM is installed or turned on. These are charged as standard outgoing texts; to avoid them, turn off outgoing texts in the line settings before installing.
numbers.risk8: To keep the number, it needs at least one qualifying activity (data, text, call or recharge) every 365 days; otherwise the number may be reclaimed.
numbers.riskAgree: I have read and accept these risks

services.title: Services
services.unavailable: The network did not answer. Try again in a moment.
services.unknown: The network did not say whether this is on.
services.blocked: This number is blocked, so its services cannot be changed.
services.failed: The change could not be made
services.dataHint: Stays on so the number keeps its signal; it cannot be turned off here.
services.smsHint: When off, outgoing texts are blocked. This stops unexpected charges from phones that send activation texts on their own.
services.voiceHint: When off, all calls are blocked.
services.voicemailHint: Records messages from unanswered calls, free of charge.
services.forwardHint: Forward every incoming call to another number, in any country. Forwarded calls are paid from the number's credit.
services.forwardInvalid: Enter the number with its country code, e.g. +44 7700 900123.
services.limitHint: Data stops for the day once this much ({currency}) is spent on it. It may not always hold: charges can go past it, and data may stay off until the next period. It does not limit calls, texts or packages. Each period is 24 hours from when the limit was set.
services.limitNow: {value} a day; {used} used in this period, until {until}.

history.title: Usage history
history.unavailable: The network did not answer for this list.
history.note: From the network's records; the newest calls and sessions may take a few minutes to appear.

diagnose.title: Diagnose
diagnose.question: Can this line connect to a mobile network?
diagnose.questionHint: Look at the signal bars for this line. Wi-Fi does not count.
diagnose.noStep1: Turn the line on in the phone's SIM settings.
diagnose.noStep2: Turn on data roaming for this line.
diagnose.noStep3: Choose the network by hand in the line's network settings.
diagnose.noStep4: Restart the phone, or use Reconnect below and wait a few minutes.
diagnose.yesStep1: Choose this line for mobile data.
diagnose.yesStep2: Check that mobile data is on under Services, and that the number has credit or a data package.
diagnose.yesStep3: Turn airplane mode on and off, then open a web page.
diagnose.reconnectHint: The SIM restarts and registers on the network again. The line drops for a few minutes. Use it when the line shows no signal.
diagnose.reconnected: The SIM is restarting. Wait a few minutes, then check the signal.
diagnose.reconnectFailed: The number could not be reconnected
diagnose.reconnectWait: Reconnected recently; you can do it again after {time}.
diagnose.note: Each card shows the latest record of its kind; times are in your own time zone.
diagnose.reconnectUnsupported: This SIM cannot be reconnected remotely. Restart the phone, or turn airplane mode on and off, to make it register on the network again.

manage.title: Manage
manage.qrHint: For a QR code that is lost or will not scan. To move to another phone you do not need one: delete the eSIM on the old phone while on Wi-Fi, wait 10 minutes, then scan the same code.
manage.qrWarning: The current QR code stops working once the new one is made. Ask only if scanning the old one failed.
manage.qrFee: {fee} comes off this number's credit; it must keep more than nothing after it.
manage.qrRequested: Requested. The new QR code usually takes about an hour.
manage.qrPending: Being made; usually about an hour
manage.qrRefunding: Declined; the fee is going back on the number
manage.qrCompleted: Done: the QR code above is the new one
manage.qrRejected: Declined; the fee went back on the number
manage.qrFailed: Not made: the fee could not be taken
manage.ownerHint: The number, its credit and its packages move to the account with the email you enter. This cannot be undone.
manage.ownerUnderstood: I understand the number leaves my account for good.
manage.ownerDone: The number is now on the other account
manage.releaseHint: The number leaves your account for good, with any credit left on it. This cannot be undone.
manage.releaseDone: The number was removed from your account
manage.voucherHint: Enter the PIN of a recharge voucher to add its value to this number's credit.
manage.voucherDone: Voucher added to the number's credit
manage.voucherFailed: The voucher could not be used
manage.billHint: A PDF of the calls, texts, data and credit added in whole past months (up to 12), from the network's records.
manage.billFailed: The bill could not be made

esim-popular.destination: Idilesi yendawo emva kwe-/esim/, umz. japan okanye europe-35-areas.

esim-plan-selector.destination: Idilesi yendawo emva kwe-/esim/, umz. japan, europe-35-areas okanye global.

esim.confirmActivate: Vula iiphakheji ezi-{count}? Ziza kubekelwa ixabiso kwaye zingapapashwa.
esim.confirmDisable: Vala iiphakheji ezi-{count}? Iintlobo zazo ziza kuphuma evenkileni kupapasho olulandelayo.
esim.confirmPublish: Papasha iindawo zeephakheji ezi-{count}? Iimveliso ezintsha zenziwa njengemizobo.
esim.priceSaved: Ixabiso ligcinwe. Papasha indawo ukuze uhlaziye ivenkile.
esim.searchPlans: Khangela igama, indawo okanye i-ID yephakheji yomboneleli
esim.noPlans: Akukho phakheji zihambelanayo. Vumelanisa umboneleli, okanye utshintshe izihluzi.
esim.previewSummary: Amaxabiso ali-{changed} kwali-{considered} ayatshintsha: {up} ayenyuka, {down} ayehla ({avg}% ngokomndilili); {active} kuwo avuliwe.
esim.previewNew: Iiphakheji ezi-{count} zifumana ixabiso lazo lokuqala.
esim.missingRates: Akukho zinga lotshintshiselwano le-{currencies}: ezo phakheji zigcina ixabiso lazo.
esim.repriced: Kugciniwe. Iiphakheji ezi-{count} zibekelwe ixabiso ngokutsha; papasha iindawo ukuze uhlaziye ivenkile.
esim.pricingHint: Ixabiso lokuthengisa = iindleko × izinga lotshintshiselwano × (1 + ukhuseleko) × (1 + inzuzo eyongezelelweyo), lingaze libe ngaphantsi kwengeniso encinci, lijikelezwe phezulu. Owona mthetho usebenzayo ocacileyo ubeka inzuzo eyongezelelweyo.
esim.minMarginHint: Yexabiso lokuthengisa; ikhusela kwinzuzo eyongezelelweyo ephantsi.
esim.fxBufferHint: Lwongezwa kwiindleko eziguqulweyo ngenxa yokuguquguquka kwezinga.
esim.threshold: Beka ixabiso ngokutsha xa izinga litshintsha ngaphezu kwe-%
esim.noRules: Akukho mithetho: zonke iiphakheji zisebenzisa inzuzo eyongezelelweyo engagqibekanga.
esim.fxHint: Amazinga e-European Central Bank, ahlaziywa yonke imihla; amva nje {date}. Izinga elibekwe ngesandla liyasebenza de lisuswe.
esim.fxRefreshed: Amazinga ka-{date} alayishiwe; iiphakheji ezi-{count} zibekelwe ixabiso ngokutsha.
esim.ruleHint: Shiya intsimi ku-"nayiphi na" ukuze ihambelane nayo yonke into. Umthetho obiza iintsimi ezininzi uyaphumelela; xa zilingana, onokubaluleka okuphezulu.
esim.syncStarted: Ukuvumelanisa kuqalile. Kunokuthatha imizuzu embalwa; hlaziya ukuze ubone inkqubela.
esim.providersHint: Ababoneleli be-eSIM apho kuthengwa khona iiphakheji. Umboneleli ovaliweyo akavumelaniswa kwaye akathengiswa.
esim.confirmCancel: Rhoxisa le eSIM kumboneleli? Iyayeka ukusebenza; buyisela umthengi imali ngokwahlukeneyo ukuba kuyimfuneko.
esim.notResent: I-imeyile ayikwazanga ukuthunyelwa; jonga idilesi ye-imeyile ye-odolo neesetingi ze-imeyile
esim.redacted: Izitshixo, iiphasiwedi neekhowudi zokuvula ziyasuswa phambi kokuba umnxeba ugcinwe.
esim.problemsHint: Ii-eSIM ezingakwazanga ukukhutshwa, okanye ezithatha ixesha elide kakhulu. I-eSIM engaphumelelanga yomthengi obhalisiweyo ibuyiselwa njengetyala levenkile ngokuzenzekelayo; eyendwendwe ifuna ukubuyiselwa ngesandla.
esim.mayStillDeliver: Umboneleli usenokuba sele eyikhuphile le eSIM. Jonga iphothali yakhe phambi kokuzama omnye umboneleli okanye ukubuyisela imali.
esim.confirmFail: Yeka ukuzama ubuyisele umthengi imali (ityala levenkile; undwendwe lufuna ukubuyiselwa ngesandla)?
esim.bindHint: I-eSIM ifundwa kumboneleli okhethiweyo nge-ICCID yayo, ibhalwe kwi-odolo kwaye ithunyelwe kumthengi nge-imeyile.
esim.confirmPlansOff: Vala zonke iiphakheji zeendawo ezi-{count}? Ziza kuphuma evenkileni kupapasho olulandelayo.
esim.confirmPublishDestinations: Papasha iindawo ezi-{count}? Iimveliso ezintsha zenziwa njengemizobo.
esim.devicesBuiltIn: Ivenkile ibonisa uluhlu olwakhelwe ngaphakathi lweemodeli ezi-{count}. Lungenise ukuze ulutshintshe, okanye wongeze iimodeli nganye nganye.
esim.devicesHint: Iifowuni neetablethi ukukhangela isixhobo evenkileni okwaziyo.
esim.jobFulfilment: Ukuzama kwakhona, ukubuza ababoneleli nee-odolo ezihlawulweyo ezingazange zingene emgceni. Rhoqo ngomzuzu.
esim.jobCatalog: Ivumelanisa iiphakheji zabo bonke ababoneleli abasebenzayo. Rhoqo kwiiyure ezi-6.
esim.jobFx: Ilayisha amazinga otshintshiselwano osuku kwaye ibeke ngokutsha amaxabiso eephakheji ezinemali etshintshileyo. Yonke imihla.
esim.jobStarted: Iqalile. Hlaziya kungekudala ukuze ubone isiphumo.
esim.jobsHint: Zisebenza xa isicwangcisi sibiza idilesi yazo nge-CRON_SECRET: kwi-Vercel ukusuka kwi-vercel.json, kwiseva yakho ukusuka kwi-cron yayo.
esim.jobsStale: Umsebenzi othile awusebenzanga ngexesha. Ngaphandle komsebenzi wokukhutshwa, ukuzama kwakhona nababoneleli abacothayo abaphinde bathathwe.
esim.mappingHint: Iphakheji yokuqala yohlobo ngalunye yeyona iphambili: uhlobo luthengiswa ngexabiso layo kwaye luthengwa kuyo kuqala; ezinye zizanywa ngokulandelelana ukuba iyala. Eyona itshiphu iyakhokela ngaphandle kokuba uphina enye.
esim.notPublishedYet: Ayikapapashwa: vula iiphakheji uze upapashe indawo kwithala leephakheji.
esim.helpCreated: Amaphepha oncedo ali-{count} enziwe kwaye apapashiwe
esim.helpPagesHint: Amaphepha asele enziwe ngeebhloko ze-eSIM; wahlele kumakhi wamaphepha kwaye uwaqhagamshele kwiimenyu zakho.
esim.topupsHint: Ukugcwalisa idatha abathengi abakuthengele ii-eSIM zabo. Ukugcwalisa okungaphumelelanga kubuyiselwa kwityala levenkile lomthengi ngokuzenzekelayo.
esim.topupMayHaveHappened: Umboneleli usenokuba sele ekwenzile oku kugcwalisa. Jonga iphothali yakhe phambi kokubuyisela imali; ukuzama kwakhona kukhuselekile.
esim.confirmFailTopup: Yeka ukuzama ubuyisele kwityala levenkile lomthengi?
esim.jobUsage: Ijonga ukusetyenziswa kwee-eSIM ezisebenzayo kubaboneleli bazo, ithumela izikhumbuzo kubathengi kwaye ihlawule imivuzo yokuthumela efanelekileyo. Rhoqo kwimizuzu engama-30.
esim.remindersHint: Zithunyelwa ngumsebenzi wokusetyenziswa nge-imeyile, nakwi-akhawunti yabathengi ababhalisiweyo: xa i-eSIM iqhagamshela, xa idatha iyaphela (nekhonkco lokugcwalisa), phambi kokuphela kwephakheji naphambi komhla wokugqibela wokufaka. Nganye ithunyelwa kube kanye.
esim.walletHint: Abathengi bongeza imali kwibhalansi yabo kwii-eSIM zam kwaye bayihlawule xa behlawula. Isixa sibhalwa njengebhalansi abayityalwayo, intlawulo njengengeniso; ibhalansi eyongezwe ngale ndlela ayibuyiselwa njengemali.
esim.referralsHint: Abathengi babelana nge-/esim/invite/[code]. Umhlobo ovula i-akhawunti ngayo ubazuzela umvuzo kwi-odolo nganye ehanjisiweyo, owongezwa kwibhalansi yabo emva kwexesha lokulinda — ubhalwe njengentengiso. Abathengi abali-{count} bajoyine ngokuthunyelwa.
esim.referralCouponHint: Ikhuphoni esetyenziswa kube kanye ye-akhawunti yakhe kuphela, eyenziwa xa ebhalisa ngekhonkco.
esim.kycHint: Abathengi baqinisekisa isazisi sabo kube kanye, kwii-eSIM zam. Iphakheji ekufunayo ingathengwa kuphela ngumthengi oqinisekisiweyo, kungaze kube lundwendwe.
esim.kycFormHint: Ukupapasha kwenza inguqulelo entsha; okuthunyelweyo kugcina inguqulelo okuyiphendulileyo.
esim.kycRulesHint: Iphakheji ifuna i-KYC ukuba ibekwe njalo kwithala leephakheji; ukuba akunjalo, ukuba iquka ilizwe elidwelisiweyo; ukuba akunjalo, ukuba umboneleli wayo utsho. Kubekwe kwithala leephakheji: {required} ziyayifuna, {notRequired} azifuni.
esim.confirmKyc: Tshintsha ukuba iiphakheji ezi-{count} zifuna ukuqinisekiswa kwesazisi na?
esim.kycNoStorage: Ugcino lweefayile alusetwanga (Iisetingi → Ugcino), ngoko abathengi abanakulayisha amaxwebhu. Lumisele, okanye upapashe ifomu engenayo imibuzo yeefayile.
esim.paymentsHint: Iintlawulo ezenziwe ngamasango entlawulo e-eSIM. I-odolo yenziwa xa isango liqinisekisa intlawulo; imbuyekezo yezi ntlawulo yenziwa ngesandla esangweni.
esim.payStripeHint: KwiDashboard yeStripe, yongeza le URL yesaziso njenge-webhook endpoint ye-checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded, checkout.session.async_payment_failed, checkout.session.expired, uze ufake imfihlo yayo yokusayina (whsec_…) kwi-webhookSecret. I-methods ayinyanzelekanga, umz. alipay,wechat_pay; ukuba ishiywe ingenanto, iStripe ibonisa iindlela zokuhlawula ezivuliweyo kwiDashboard yayo.
esim.checkoutDisplayHint: Ulandelelwano abathengi abazibona ngalo iindlela zokuhlawula, eyona ikhethiweyo xa kuvulwa indawo yokuhlawula, kunye nomfanekiso ngamnye. Kuboniswa kuphela iindlela ezivuliweyo. Ibhalansi ye-akhawunti ihlala iza kuqala xa yanele ukuhlawula i-odolo.
esim.esimGatewaysHint: Amasango adityaniswe yimodyuli ye-eSIM. Ngalinye elivuliweyo nelilungisiweyo yindlela yokuhlawula eyahlukileyo kwindawo yokuhlawula; i-odolo yenziwa xa isango liqinisekisa intlawulo, kwaye imbuyekezo yenziwa ngesandla esangweni.
esim.paymentsMoved: Amasango, ulandelelwano lwawo kunye nemifanekiso kwindawo yokuhlawula, kunye neentlawulo zokuhlawula zisetwa kwiiSetingi → Intlawulo.
esim.payConfirmRefunded: Bhala ukuba i-{amount} ibuyiselwe kumthengi nge-{method}?
esim.migConfirm: Ngenisa ngoku abathengi, iibhalansi, ukuthunyelwa nee-eSIM ezisebenzayo zevenkile endala? Abathengi abathunyelelwa ii-imeyile. Ukuyiqhuba kwakhona kamva kongeza okutsha kuphela.
esim.migStarted: Iqalile; eli phepha liza kuhlaziywa xa sele igqityiwe
esim.migHint: Izisa abathengi (neephasiwedi zabo ezindala), iibhalansi, ukuthunyelwa nee-eSIM ezisebenzayo ukusuka kwivenkile endala. Ii-odolo ezindala azingeniswa. Vumelanisa ikhathalogu yomboneleli ngamnye kuqala: i-eSIM ephakheji yayo ingekabikho apha iyashiywa, kwaye ukungenisa okulandelayo kuyayithatha.
esim.migNoSource: Ayiqwalaselwanga — beka i-LEGACY_MYSQL_HOST, LEGACY_MYSQL_DATABASE, LEGACY_MYSQL_USER ne-LEGACY_MYSQL_PASSWORD kwi-.env uze uqalise kwakhona.
esim.cancelHint: Umthengi angarhoxisa i-eSIM engekafakwa, kwiphakheji umboneleli wayo ayiphawule njengebuyiselwayo, xa umboneleli erhoxisa nge-API yakhe. Umboneleli ubuzwa kuqala; umthengi ubuyiselwa imali kuphela xa evuma.
esim.reportsHint: Intengiso ye-eSIM nengeniso epheleleyo ngamaxabiso neendleko zomboneleli ezabhalwa xa i-eSIM nganye yayithengwa. Izixa nge-USD; iintsuku nge-UTC.
esim.reportCostUnknown: Intengiso eyi-{count} ayinazo iindleko zomboneleli nge-USD (bekungekho zinga lotshintshiselwano ngelo xesha) kwaye ayifakwanga kwingeniso.
esim.reportNoSnapshot: Ii-eSIM ezi-{count} ezikhutshwe kweli xesha zathengwa phambi kokuba kugcinwe iirekhodi zentengiso, okanye zangeniswa, kwaye azibalwa.
esim.reportVoided: Ii-eSIM ezi-{count} ({amount}) zirhoxisiwe okanye zibuyiselwe imali kwaye azibalwa njengentengiso.
esim.confirmApprove: Thenga zonke ii-eSIM zale odolo ngoku?
esim.confirmReject: Ungathengi nto kule odolo? Emva koko buyisela intlawulo kwi-Storify (Ii-odolo → Buyisela) apho ivela khona.
esim.riskHint: Bamba ii-eSIM ze-odolo ehlawulweyo ukuze zihlolwe ngumntu phambi kokuthenga nantoni na kumboneleli. Ii-odolo ezibanjiweyo zivela phantsi kwe-eSIM → Iingxaki, ukuze zivunywe okanye zaliwe. U-0 uvala umthetho.
esim.riskOrders: Hlola xa umthengi sele enee-odolo ezininzi kangaka
esim.campaignsHint: Iphulo liphepha elinebhena nekhowudi yekhuphoni yeendawo ezikhethiweyo, kwimihla yalo. Ikhowudi yikhuphoni ye-Storify ehambelana nephulo, kwaye isebenza kuphela kwii-eSIM zezo ndawo.
esim.campaignConfirmDelete: Susa eli phulo? Iphepha lalo liyasuka, kwaye ikhowudi yekhuphoni iyayeka ukusebenza.
esim.campaignActive: Liyasebenza: iphepha nekhowudi ziyasebenza phakathi kwemihla
esim.feesHint: Zongezwa kwi-odolo ngokwendlela ehlawulwa ngayo: isixa esimiselweyo kunye nepesenti yempahla, ziboniswa xa kuhlawulwa njengomgca othi "Intlawulo yenkonzo yokuhlawula" kwaye zibuyiselwa kunye ne-odolo. Ukuhlawula ngebhalansi, nokugcwalisa isipaji, akunantlawulo.
esim.balanceHoldHint: Bonke ababoneleli bale eSIM baphelelwe yibhalansi. Gcwalisa omnye: kuzanywa kwakhona rhoqo kwimizuzu eli-10 (okanye zama ngoku) de kube ngu-{until}, emva koko kubuyiselwe imali.
esim.navHint: Ibha esezantsi kwivenkile kwiifowuni neetablethi. Vula okanye uvale iithebhu, uzicwangcise kwaye uzinike amagama amatsha. Ziboniswa ezingama-{max} kuphela; iMenyu ihlala ikhona, kuba yiyo kuphela indlela eya kwimenyu esecaleni kwifowuni.
esim.navDefault: Ivenkile ibonisa ibha yayo. Gcina ukuze usebenzise esetwe apha.
esim.menuHint: Imenyu evulwa yithebhu yeMenyu kwiifowuni neetablethi. Fihla iinxalenye ongazifuniyo, kwaye udwelise amaphepha e-eSIM okanye amakhonkco akho phantsi kweKhaya. Amakhonkco aphakathi asavela kwimenyu yentloko phantsi kwe-Ivenkile ye-intanethi → Ukukhangela indlela.
esim.numbersOnlySupplier: Amakhadi eenombolo (isitokhwe singeniswe phantsi kwe-eSIM → Iinombolo)
esim.numbersHint: Amakhadi eenombolo e-TopConnect asesitokhweni. {available} akhululekile · {reserved} abanjiwe · {sold} athengisiwe · {retired} akasathengiswa
esim.searchNumbers: Inombolo, i-ICCID, ibhetshi okanye i-imeyile yomthengi
esim.importNumbersHint: Ikhadi elinye kumgca ngamnye, njengoko i-TopConnect iwathumela: MSISDN ICCID LPA PIN1 PUK1 PIN2 PUK2, ahlulwe ngezithuba, iithebhu okanye iikoma. Umgca unokuphela ngexabiso lawo nesixa esongezelelweyo. Iinombolo esele zisesitokhweni ziyatsitywa.
esim.dialCodeHint: Shiya ikhowudi yelizwe ingenanto xa yonke inombolo sele iqala ngekhowudi yayo.
esim.numbersCheckResult: {imported} bezinokungeniswa · {existing} sele zisesitokhweni · imigca eli-{problems} eneengxaki
esim.numbersImportResult: {imported} zingenisiwe · {existing} sele zisesitokhweni · imigca eli-{problems} eneengxaki
esim.numberPackagesHint: Iipakethi zedatha umnini wenombolo anokuzithenga. Iindleko lixabiso le-TopConnect, elifakwa ekhadini phambi kokuvulwa kwepakethi; ixabiso lilandela imithetho yamaxabiso ngaphandle kokuba ulibeke.
esim.loadPacketsNeeds: Kufuneka umboneleli we-TopConnect avuliwe nenombolo esesitokhweni
esim.noPackets: Akukabikho phakheji zedatha. Zilayishe kwi-TopConnect okanye wongeze enye ngesandla.
esim.packetIdHint: I-ID yepakethi yikhowudi yepakethi ye-TopConnect, leyo ivulwa ekhadini.
esim.packetCountriesHint: Amazwe apho isebenza khona (iikhowudi, umz. FR, DE, IT)
esim.numberProductProblem: Iinombolo azikakwazi ukuthengwa: imveliso yevenkile ezithengiswa ngayo ayikwazanga ukwenziwa ({reason}).
esim.numberSettingsHint: Yonke inombolo ithengiswa nokutshaja kokuqala. Okona kutshaja kuncinci kusebenza kokuqala nakwezilandelayo: izixa ezipheleleyo ngemali yekhadi ({currency}).
esim.providerCurrencyHint: Iindleko ezingenayo imali yazo zifundwa ngale mali kwaye ziguqulelwe kwi-USD ngezinga lotshintshiselwano kunye nokhuseleko.
esim.providerCurrencyInvalid: Faka ikhowudi yemali enoonobumba abathathu, njenge-USD okanye i-EUR
esim.packetLoadHint: I-TopConnect idwelisa iiphakheji zenethiwekhi ikhadi elikuyo. Ikhadi elingasetyenziswanga alikho kuyo nayiphi na inethiwekhi, ngoko faka ikhowudi yenethiwekhi (MCC+MNC) yenethiwekhi iiphakheji zezayo, umz. 24801. Ikhowudi efakiweyo iyakhunjulwa.
esim.destinationNamesHint: Umthengisi uyibiza ngokuthi "{name}". Shiya ulwimi lungenanto ukuze kuboniswe igama elizenzekelayo ngengwevu: igama lelizwe kwilizwe elinye, elomthengisi kwamanye.
esim.mergeHint: Kwiindawo ezimbini eziyindawo enye kodwa ababoneleli bazinika amagama ahlukeneyo. Emva kokudibanisa, iipakethe zale ndawo, kunye nezo ziza kongezwa kamva, ziya kuthengiswa phantsi kwendawo oyikhethileyo, kwaye idilesi yeli phepha iya kuthumela apho. Iindawo zelizwe elinye zidityaniswa ngokuzenzekelayo.
esim.mergeConfirm: Dibanisa "{from}" no "{into}"? Imveliso yayo iya kuba yidrafti kwaye idilesi yayo iya kuthumela apho.
esim.unmerged: Ukudityaniswa kurhoxisiwe. Imveliso yaloo ndawo ihlala iyidrafti de uphinde uyibonise.
esim.qrEnabled: Shoppers may ask for a new QR code
esim.qrRequestsHint: Order the new eSIM profile from TopConnect, then paste its full activation code (LPA:1$…). It replaces the number's code. Declining puts the fee back on the number.
esim.qrNote: Note for the customer (needed to decline)
